title: Validate section
description: The validate section of an agentic.json file: which checks agent-validate runs, where each one looks, and how severe their findings are.

skip.description: Directory names that no check descends into, in addition to the default skip list.

checks.description: The settings of each check by name. A check that is not listed runs with its defaults.

paths.description: The directories or files the check reads, relative to the repository root. They replace the defaults of the check.

level.description: The most severe level a finding of the check keeps. A finding above it is reported at this level.

options.description: The options of the check. Each check defines and validates its own.
